timeline.summary: On 6 May 2026, NCLT Mumbai Bench orally admitted a ₹353.79 Cr insolvency petition against Prime Focus Limited filed by Reliance Alpha Services; the company has filed an appeal with NCLAT seeking a stay.
On 11 May 2026, NCLAT continued the interim order staying IRP steps in the insolvency appeal and adjourned the matter to May 12, 2026.
NCLAT stayed the NCLT insolvency order against Prime Focus conditional upon depositing ₹353.80 Cr by May 20, 2026; next hearing on July 9, 2026.
Prime Focus complied with the NCLAT order by depositing ₹353.79 Cr ahead of the due date, maintaining the stay on insolvency proceedings.
On May 27, 2026, the Supreme Court dismissed Raspalfa's appeal against the NCLAT stay, and the NCLAT dismissed the application to vacate the stay, listing the main appeal for July 9, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,384.47 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹82.35 Cr (against a loss of ₹230.97 Cr a year earlier).
On May 29, 2026, Prime Focus released its Q4 and FY2026 investor presentation reporting Q4 revenue of ₹1,384 Cr and EBITDA of ₹488 Cr.

Prime Focus reported Q1FY27 revenue of ₹1,267 Cr (+23.8% YoY) and EBITDA of ₹301 Cr, but a ₹66 Cr exceptional charge including a ₹71 Cr NCLT settlement turned net profit to a ₹46 Cr loss (₹20 Cr excluding exceptional items).
On October 15, 2026, Prime Focus announced board approval for related party transactions and an EGM on November 7, 2026, regarding Brahma AI investments.
